label: See the vault
description: Members, devices, the audit trail and the vault's name. No secret values.

label: Read secrets
description: Passwords and other secrets, and their past values.

label: Add and edit secrets
description: Save a new secret, or change one.

label: Trash and restore secrets
description: Move a secret to the trash, or bring it back.

label: Delete secrets for good
description: Removes a trashed secret and its history. It can't be undone.

label: Give devices access
description: Register a device, hand it the vault key, or revoke one.

label: Change members and roles
description: Give someone a role, remove a member, or set the role newcomers get.

label: Rename the vault and rotate its key
description: The vault's name, and which key new writes use.
